title: approvals: every approval notification reaches the recipient with an empty body — the service puts its text in payload.message, messaging reads payload.body (comment and request-info text are lost)
body:
QA-source: #21845 · approvals.sla-escalation · acceptance[3]

Clause A4 of `approvals.sla-escalation` (rev 2) fails in the follow-up run #21845 (subject `316be321e`); an independent verifier (RUNNER rule 7) confirmed it from source and widened the scope: medium, predates 17.6.0.

## Reproduction

1. Boot the showcase. User A comments on an approval request where user B is a party (or: an SLA breach with `notifySubmitter:true`, see #21845).
2. As user B, `GET /api/v1/notifications`.

- Expected: the notification's body carries the text (the comment, the request-info question, the escalation action).
- Actual: title only, `body ""` (inbox `body_md ''`).

## Mechanism

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` — the notify helper (~1373-1410) and all 12 call sites (OOO substituted / skipped, returned, reassigned, reminders, request-info, comment, escalated, SLA breached) put the text in `payload.message`.
- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/dispatcher.ts:341` and the emit-time notification (`messaging-service.ts` ~1101, ~1221) read only `payload.body`; the `EmitInput` contract documents title/body/url. The flow notify node and @mention producers already send `body`; approvals is the only producer affected.

## Done when

Approval notifications send `body` (or the dispatcher honours a documented alias, not both), and a test reads a comment's text from the recipient's notification.
